title: Bare-root '/' cannot be added to public suffix or ungated marker tables
answers: why can't I add / to the public routes list
fail-closed exemption for the root path matches too much
body:
Invariant: the root path '/' must not be added to _PUBLIC_ROUTE_SUFFIXES or to _KNOWN_UNGATED_ROUTE_MARKERS in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py.
Enforced by: _matches_route_suffix, where stripping the suffix from '/api/2.0/' leaves exactly an API-version prefix, so the suffix would match it; and the 'marker in path' branch, where a marker of '/' matches every path.
Breaks if skipped: API paths such as /api/2.0/... become public or ungated under the fail-closed net, bypassing authorization.
Fix pattern: map bare paths through the route-to-validator map instead, applying _add_static_prefix at the call site so the exact key is matched.
Applies: any edit to the public-suffix or ungated-marker tables in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py.
applies: Changes to _PUBLIC_ROUTE_SUFFIXES, _KNOWN_UNGATED_ROUTE_MARKERS or the fail-closed route matching in basic-auth.
says: Making the root web page public accidentally exposes all protected backend programming interfaces.
Unauthenticated users can access private server endpoints after making the landing route public.
User authentication is completely bypassed across all routes when opening the root path.
Keep the home address publicly accessible without disabling login requirements on internal endpoints.
search: The bare-root path '/' must not be added to _PUBLIC_ROUTE_SUFFIXES or _KNOWN_UNGATED_ROUTE_MARKERS in basic-auth route matching. Because _matches_route_suffix matches any path ending in an API-version prefix and the marker check matches every path, adding '/' makes protected routes like /api/2.0/ publicly accessible. Bare paths must instead be registered in the route-to-validator map with _add_static_prefix applied at the call site for exact key matching. This invariant applies to all modifications of public-suffix and ungated-marker tables in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py.
